amendments.summary: RWC-P becomes the primary benchmark and runs first. Logic-generated fixtures and the two untouched target holdout recordings are no longer prerequisites for the RWC development and holdout evaluation. A manual check of a few representative iOS screen recordings becomes the final domain check.
unchanged: RWC-P 8-development/4-holdout split and its manifest checksum
exclusion of all consumed Phase 2J tracks
--allow-holdout gating for RWC holdout analyzer output
metrics, artifact paths, and target candidate checksums
amendments.status: Approved unchanged in issue #8 on 2026-08-10 before the holdout was opened.

evaluationOrder.name: rwc-development
evaluationOrder.note: Primary benchmark. RWC-P aligned MIDI, beat, chord, structure, melody, and vocal annotations may all be used as evidence or diagnostics.

evaluationOrder.name: rwc-holdout
evaluationOrder.note: Consumed once in CR2E on 2026-08-10 after issue #8 locked the thresholds; Chordino missed the oracle root minimum.

evaluationOrder.name: target-domain-manual-check
evaluationOrder.note: Blocked after CR2E missed the frozen RWC oracle root minimum. Not a scored blind holdout.

resolvedInputs.question: What does 'RWC results are satisfactory' mean numerically?
How many representative iOS screen recordings, and which scenarios must the final manual check cover?
resolvedInputs.resolution: Three recordings covering full band with bass, piano/guitar plus vocal with no dedicated bass, and melody/ornament-heavy repeated sections with one legitimate variation.

rwcPrimaryGate.note: Approved unchanged in issue #8 on 2026-08-10 before the holdout was opened. These values remain immutable after the CR2E result.

basis.note: The consumed Phase 2J holdout reached 49.0% MajMin with oracle timing and 39.9% end-to-end. That corpus is a different, consumed split and is cited only to show the size of the proposed jump.

density.rule: Analyzer changes per minute divided by reference changes per minute, after merging adjacent equal labels. Over-segmentation was the original product complaint, so density is a gate rather than a diagnostic.

targetHoldoutReferenceOrCorrectedTiming.appliesTo: Retained for a future scored target holdout. The 2026-07-25 amendment replaced the blocking two-recording holdout with a manual domain check, so these values no longer gate CR6 on their own.

missingBoundaryIncreaseMaximum.rule: Fail when both limits are exceeded.

retainedExperiment.rule: Meet both majority-of-track requirements and either the aggregate MajMin gain or correction-time reduction without exceeding regression tolerances.

holdoutAccess.rwc: Consumed once at CR2E on 2026-08-10. Do not tune against, rerun candidates on, or reinterpret this holdout. Dry-run availability checks remain harmless, but no further analyzer decision may use the split.
holdoutAccess.target: The two untouched holdout slots remain defined but no longer block the RWC evaluation. If they are ever supplied, the same rule applies: do not run analyzer output or inspect their references before the integrated gate. The final manual domain check uses ordinary representative recordings, not these slots.
